To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a system that can predict ICD 10 codes from clinical narratives.

1) a hierarchical classification model trained on ICD 9 concepts can be used to identify potentially useful concepts and codes from ICD 10; 2) the confidence that each of these concepts is present in a procedure code can be estimated from the clinical narrative; 3) the confidence of each ICD 10 candidate code can be estimated using features derived form concept confidence scores.
the system achieves an average accuracy of 82.7% on the held out test set.
